correctness.rationale: For odd q, every traceless square-zero 2x2 matrix has coordinates (a,b,c) with a²+bc=0. Commutation forces rank<=1 for the 3xr coordinate matrix. Nonzero residue tuple is smooth of dimension r+1 and has B=(q+1)(q^r-1) base points, lifting by q^((m-1)(r+1)). Zero residues factor out t; quadratic homogeneity gives q^(3r) C_(m-2), with free high coefficients. The resulting recurrence generates stated rational series. For r>=3 the zero-fiber components have dimension r-2 more than the nonzero-origin closure, inductively giving floor(m/2)+1 components and specified dimensions. Direct independently exhaustive enumeration of all q3,r2,m2 traceless commuting square-zero pairs gave C2=1593, matching formula; q3,r2,m1 base gives C1=33.
